d: A strange noise, an unexpected animal visitor or a creature in need of help can send Turtleman on an entirely new adventure! Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, and Neal James take on a series of memorable wildlife rescue and capture missions involving some fascinating and hard-to-catch animals. From tricky snake encounters and turtle catching to raccoons, mink and other wild visitors, these assignments put their animal-handling skills to the test.
